baseline.rule: two Layer 7 selected NAV-defense lines before adding overheat; SCORE_MAX=5.0 for score-veto baseline

data_snapshot.pool_rule: QQQ/EWG/EWJ/GLD from 2007 start; CN_CYB_399006 joins from own data with no backfill

three_directions.fixed_same_side: fixed MA60 bias and 20-day bias momentum same-side thresholds
three_directions.adaptive_quantile: per-asset rolling 252-session bias quantile thresholds, same-side trigger
three_directions.score_veto: rebuild the signal with different SCORE_MAX values

execution_assumptions.signal: close-to-close weighted-slope ranking with R2 removed, switch buffer, and staged entry
execution_assumptions.target_vol: disabled because Layer 5 rejected target-vol for both carried lines
execution_assumptions.momentum_decay: disabled because Layer 6 rejected momentum decay for both carried lines
execution_assumptions.nav_defense: Layer 7 selected NAV-defense line is included before testing overheat
execution_assumptions.overheat: T close overheat state sets next-session scale; effective scale is shifted one session
execution_assumptions.adaptive_quantile_threshold: rolling bias quantiles use prior sessions only via shift(1)
execution_assumptions.mixed_market_calendar: diagnostic A-share calendar with US proxy forward-filled; base trades on stale trade legs blocked
